title: Review of lab 1's membrane_kinds (SIBD): fresh seeds 21 and 22 give walled cells from noise with a link ring (L rim/core 1.64, 64/78 membrane-like) that divide to generation 4 (14 and 11 persistent splits, merge/split 0.07-0.10)
summary: First labkit pack of threads/autopoiesis/worlds/membrane_kinds/world.py on fresh seeds 21 and 22 (128^2, 200 frames, t=10000). From noise (t=0) cells with a wall and a link ring form by t~850 and divide by pinching (dumbbells at t=1750-3450, rerun sheet); late in the run the second catalyst kind K2 (pink) spreads through many cells. Seed 21: 71 splits, 14 persistent, generation 4, merges 5; L link rim/core 1.64, rim/out 4.91, 64/78 individuals membrane-like; wall indicator 1.80, 51/78. Seed 22: 11 persistent splits, generation 4, merge/split 0.10; L and wall membrane-like.

observations.B: pack/seed21/radial.png: L link rim/core 1.64, rim/out 4.91, 64/78 membrane-like (links made by the cell's catalyst, adsorbed by the chi drift)
observations.D: pack/seed21/lineage.png: 14 persistent splits, generation 4, merge/split 0.07; seed 22: 11, generation 4

verdicts.limitation: The ring is chi drift up the wall indicator of the cell's own link product (L3 quasi-equilibrium clause); I ran no chi=0 ablation. Kind takeover by K2 late in the run is the infection lab 1 already recorded (L7 Contradicted), not reproduction evidence. 128^2 only.
